tools.description: AWS CLI v2 with improved performance, enhanced security, and new features
tools.usage:
aws configure # Setup credentials
aws s3 ls # List S3 buckets
aws ec2 describe-instances --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].{ID:InstanceId,State:State.Name}' --output table
aws sts get-caller-identity # Check current identity

tools.description: AWS CLI command completion engine for bash and zsh shells
tools.usage: complete -C aws_completer aws # Enable bash completion\naws s3 <TAB> # Auto-complete S3 commands\naws ec2 describe-<TAB> # Auto-complete EC2 operations
